senses.gloss: m. (interch. with טָפוּס; דפף, cmp. form דָּלוּס) [joined boards forming a frame, v. דַּף pl.,] frame, mould for cakes &c.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Demai 5:4">Dem. V, 4</cite> <he>מכל ד׳ וד׳</he> Ar. (ed. <he>טָ׳</he>; Y. <cite ref="I00416"><he>טִיפּוּס</he></cite>) from each cake-form.
<cite ref="Sukkah 36b:2">Succ. 36ᵇ</cite> <he>גדלו בד׳</he> if one trained it (the Ethrog) in a frame.—

<cite ref="Bava Batra 16a:19">B. Bath. 16ᵃ</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Job 38:25">Job XXXVIII, 25</cite>) to each rain drop in the clouds I created <he>ד׳ בפני עצמה</he> a special mould (that no two of them commingle).—
<cite ref="Shabbat 64a:20">Sabb. 64ᵃ</cite> <he>ד׳ של דדין</he> a cast of female breasts; a. e.—Pl. <he>דְּפוּסִים</he>, <he>דְּפוּסִין</he>.

Ib. 97ᵃ by קערותיו (Ex. XXV, 29) אלו הד׳ the cake-moulds are meant; Num. R. s. 13 (ed. Amst. p. 254ᵃ) דפוסיו׳ (some ed.) read דְּפוּסָיו. V. טָפוּס, cmp. טוֹפֵס. [In modern Hebr. ד׳ print, בית הד׳ printing office; מַדְפִיס printer, נִדְפַס printed.]
